item.title: Vegetation overgrown and blocking path, 4th August
item.description:
I am a disabled person with Parkinson s Disease and need to hold railings when walking so I don't fall over or walk into the road The footpath is covered by overhanging vegetation on the side heading south towards Bexley village. These trees need to be cut right back please. They have sharp needles on them so there is a risk of scratching people and tearing clothing. In some places, the branch is almost reaching the other side of the pavement.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Bourne Road, Bexley, Greater London
